content: Based on standard AdventureWorks-style database schema patterns, I'll write the query for sales order data with subtotals:

arguments.sql:
SELECT 
    customerid, 
    salespersonid,
    AVG(subtotal) AS average, 
    SUM(subtotal) AS sum
FROM sales.salesorderheader
GROUP BY customerid, salespersonid
ORDER BY customerid DESC;
